title: Help by role | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Which help is relevant to me?
hero.lead: Kaderblick shows different content and actions depending on your role, assignments and the selected club or team. Choose the entry point that matches your task.

body:
ℹ️
Why your view may look different
A role name alone does not always determine your full access. The selected club or team, a relationship to a player or coach, and a specific responsibility can also determine what you can see and change.

Players, parents and coaches

⚽
Players
Own events, attendance, matchday, tasks, team, training proofs and personal details.
👪
Parents and carers
Follow and manage information and responses for an assigned player.
📋
Coaches and coaching staff
Organise squads, events, formations, match plans, matchday, proofs, tasks and reports.

Club and team organisation

🛡️
Club and team administration
Maintain people, teams, user assignments, requests and organisational master data.
🛟
Supporters
Support assigned clubs or teams within the permissions granted for that assignment.
🤝
Staff and officials
Help for team management, medical support, media work, board duties and other responsibilities.

Specialised work areas

💶
Treasurers
Team or club funds, billing, personal tab and penalty catalogue.
🎽
Kit and equipment managers
Inventory, availability, issue and return of club or team equipment.
⚙️
Super administration
Platform-wide master data, rules, templates, monitoring and system settings.

If an area is missing

First check that you are using the correct account and that it is assigned to the expected club, team, player or coach. If the area is still missing, contact the responsible club or team administration.

Recommended starting point by task

PerspectiveCheck firstTypical next areas
PlayerOwn profile, team and upcoming eventsMy matchday, tasks, messages, training proofs
Parent or carerAssigned player and their teamCalendar, attendance, matchday, messages
Coach or coaching staffCurrent team and seasonSquad, calendar, games, formations, match plan, reports
Team or club administrationAdministrative context and responsibilityUser relationships, teams, staff, officials, requests
TreasurerTeam or club fundCash book, billing, tabs, penalty catalogue
Equipment managerAssigned club or teamInventory, issue and return
Media workApproved organisational contextNews, games, media and communication
SupporterSupported club or teamOnly areas granted for that assignment
Super administrationPlatform-wide scopeMaster data, rules, templates, monitoring and settings

Holding several roles

One person can have several relationships and responsibilities. First select the club or team affected by the task, then perform the action in that context. This makes it clear for whom and at which organisational level a change was made.

Requesting useful support

State the visible page title, the selected club or team, your task and the step at which you cannot continue. Never send passwords, sign-in links or other confidential access data.

Your complete role path

Choose a card above. The complete path opens here.

⚽

Role path

Working as a player

Your personal workflows extend beyond the Players master-data page.

Your working context

Your linked player profile, selected team and season determine the visible records.

Relevant guides

DashboardUpcoming events, tasks and open items.My matchdayAttendance, selection, rides and matchday tasks.Calendar and eventsEvents, details and responses.TasksAssigned and created work.Training evidenceSubmission, assignment and review.My profilePersonal data, settings, absences and documents.MessagesCommunication with the team.XP and Hall of FameLevels, titles, rules and rankings.

Where to start

Check Dashboard and Calendar, then handle the next event, response or task.

Boundary

A player relationship does not grant squad, line-up or administration management.

↑ Back to role selection
👪

Role path

Acting as a parent or carer

You act for a specifically assigned player, not through a broad parent role.

Your working context

Confirm player and team before every response; multiple relationships are shown separately.

Relevant guides

DashboardUpcoming events, tasks and open items.Calendar and eventsEvents, details and responses.My matchdayAttendance, selection, rides and matchday tasks.Car poolsJourneys and available seats.Training evidenceSubmission, assignment and review.My profilePersonal data, settings, absences and documents.MessagesCommunication with the team.

Where to start

Select the player, then review Calendar and My matchday.

Boundary

A parent relationship is not a coaching or administration assignment.

↑ Back to role selection
📋

Role path

Working as a coach or coaching staff

This path covers complete sporting team operations, not only coach records.

Your working context

Select team and season; games, events and reports may add their own context.

Relevant guides

Clubs and teamsOrganisation, teams, seasons and squads.PlayersProfiles, assignments, absences and documents.Calendar and eventsEvents, details and responses.GamesDetails, squads, events and match flow.Line-upsFormations and tactical phases.My matchdayAttendance, selection, rides and matchday tasks.Training evidenceSubmission, assignment and review.TasksAssigned and created work.ReportsTemplates, filters and results.Video analysisVideos, events, clips and analysis.TournamentsSchedules, fixtures and results.

Where to start

Choose team and season, then open the relevant training, game or player.

Boundary

Coaching does not replace administration, treasury or equipment assignments.

↑ Back to role selection
🛡️

Role path

Administering a club or team

This path combines organisational structure, accounts and assignments.

Your working context

Distinguish club and team level and confirm the scope before editing.

Relevant guides

Clubs and teamsOrganisation, teams, seasons and squads.Users and assignmentsAccounts, relationships and requests.Staff and officialsResponsibilities at club and team level.PlayersProfiles, assignments, absences and documents.CoachesProfiles, licences and team assignments.VenuesLocations and organisational use.Billing and subscriptionSubscription and billing context.AdministrationAdministrative areas in context.

Where to start

Review organisation, user requests and then staff and person assignments.

Boundary

Club or team administration is not automatically platform-wide.

↑ Back to role selection
🛟

Role path

Working as a Supporter

A Supporter works within an assigned organisation and granted functions.

Your working context

Confirm the supported club or team and the actual support task.

Relevant guides

Clubs and teamsOrganisation, teams, seasons and squads.Users and assignmentsAccounts, relationships and requests.GamesDetails, squads, events and match flow.Video analysisVideos, events, clips and analysis.ReportsTemplates, filters and results.Feedback and helpReport problems and missing access.

Where to start

Select the organisation and open the area required by the task.

Boundary

Supporter does not define one fixed feature set; assignment and permission do.

↑ Back to role selection
🤝

Role path

Working as staff or an official

Club and team functions cover different operational duties.

Your working context

Check whether the function belongs to a team or club.

Relevant guides

Staff and officialsResponsibilities at club and team level.Clubs and teamsOrganisation, teams, seasons and squads.Calendar and eventsEvents, details and responses.TasksAssigned and created work.MessagesCommunication with the team.NewsPublish organisational information.Video analysisVideos, events, clips and analysis.WatchlistFollow people where available.

Where to start

Confirm function and level, then choose the corresponding operational area.

Boundary

Staff or official is not one uniform role.

↑ Back to role selection
💶

Role path

Working as a treasurer

This path connects cashbook, balances, fines and billing.

Your working context

Distinguish team and club funds and verify the transaction context.

Relevant guides

CashbookTransactions, categories, receipts and history.My balancePersonal balances, consumption and payments.Fines catalogueFine types and their use.Billing and subscriptionSubscription and billing context.ReportsTemplates, filters and results.AdministrationAdministrative areas in context.

Where to start

Confirm organisation and fund before posting or changing a balance.

Boundary

Treasurer access does not grant general administration or another fund.

↑ Back to role selection
🎽

Role path

Managing equipment and kit

For kit managers and other explicitly assigned equipment roles.

Your working context

Confirm organisation and inventory; personal sizes and stock are separate.

Relevant guides

InventoryStock, availability, issue and return.Clothing sizesSize overview, reminders and orders.Clubs and teamsOrganisation, teams, seasons and squads.TasksAssigned and created work.MessagesCommunication with the team.

Where to start

Check stock, missing sizes and outstanding returns.

Boundary

Equipment responsibility does not grant user, finance or sporting administration.

↑ Back to role selection
⚙️

Role path

Working as a super administrator

Platform administration is separate from one club or team.

Your working context

Determine whether a change is platform-wide or organisation-specific.

Relevant guides

AdministrationAdministrative areas in context.Users and assignmentsAccounts, relationships and requests.Clubs and teamsOrganisation, teams, seasons and squads.XP and Hall of FameLevels, titles, rules and rankings.ReportsTemplates, filters and results.Billing and subscriptionSubscription and billing context.Feedback and helpReport problems and missing access.

Where to start

Determine scope and inspect affected organisations or accounts before saving.

Boundary

The superadmin view does not represent what other roles can see.
